Hi all — quick technical write-up based on the profile Jane sent. High-level guidance below; happy to jump on a short call to walk through numbers.

1) GPU comparisons (13B encoder-decoder, mixed fp16/ACTQ workloads):
- A100 40GB: mature, predictable performance. For streaming p95 ~140-180ms at 8-10 concurrent streams depending on batch sizing and KV cache efficacy. Better price-per-token but less peak headroom vs H100.
- H100 80GB: better sustained throughput for large-context workloads and more headroom for concurrency/bursts; we typically see ~20-35% higher tokens/sec for similar latencies versus A100 for 13B family models. H100 also gives more room for larger KV cache and caching more prompt history.

2) Mapping SLOs to reserved throughput / sizing:
- Your sustained 120k tokens/min = 2k tokens/sec. For conservative headroom (2x) and burst support, we recommend reserving ~4k tokens/sec.
- On H100, one GPU can often sustain ~2.5k-3.5k tokens/sec for this model in our tests (with dynamic batching and streaming-friendly kernel paths). That implies a 2-GPU Dedicated pool (H100s) for the baseline reservation with autoscale/burst to 3-4 GPUs for peak events.
- On A100 40GB, one GPU is nearer to ~1.6k-2.2k tokens/sec for similar latency targets; so 3 GPUs reserved would be the safe baseline.

3) Concurrency & streaming guidance:
- Streaming p95 targets depend heavily on per-token generation time + network hop. For p95 <=150ms, we need per-token generation typically <=100ms to leave room for RT and SDK buffering. That’s feasible on H100 with smaller micro-batches and per-request KV cache priming (cache warm).
- For 12-16 concurrent streams, prefer fewer large GPUs (H100) vs many smaller ones to reduce scheduling overhead. Also consider pinning model shards to avoid cross-GPU scatter for low-latency streaming.

4) Validation/test plan (proposed):
- Phase A (synthetic): 4-hour run with uniform prompt distribution to validate raw tokens/sec and latency percentiles across A100/H100.
- Phase B (real prompts): 24-hour run using your sample production prompts (we’ll stream from a test harness and record per-token timings + network RTT).
- Phase C (burst tests): 2-hour window with sudden 2x-3x concurrency to validate autoscale/burst behavior and graceful degradation/fallback.

5) Metrics & deliverables:
- p50/p95/p99 token latency, per-token timing series, concurrency vs latency heatmap, cost-per-1k-tokens for reserved vs burst usage.
- We’ll provide a recommended Dedicated SKU (GPU count & type) and an estimated monthly commit.

I’ve attached a small sample of local throughput runs we’ve done for a similar 13B model (throughput_test_results.csv). Note: exact numbers will vary with prompt distribution and sequence lengths; the plan above accounts for that.

If you’re okay with the H100 recommendation, I’d propose starting Phase A on Thu 11/19 9am PT and running through the day. Marissa — please confirm the booking and I’ll reserve the GPU pool and prep the harness.
